reason: Threshold is right, but 5.15.3 is wrongly called the latest 5.x; the repo changelog records QtWebEngine 5.15.4.
Calls the combination impossible, yet QVersionNumber.normalized() makes 5.4 equal 5.4.0, matching the pkg_resources-compatible test behavior.
Reads named domains as an exclusive URL gate; verifier calls them coverage only, but the requirement wording plausibly signals @include restrictions.
Recalls a nonexistent --diff-mode flag with new/strict values; this baseline only exposes -diff bound to Config.Diff.
Config fields and flags are only part; status constants, filtering, CveIDDiffFormat, CountDiff and previous-only entries are left out.
Parse-then-eq/ge leaves out the required normalized() step and tuple unpacking, so the 5.4 vs 5.4.0 exact match fails.
version_check and is_new_qtwebkit parts hold, but the crashdialog test file contains no version inputs at all.
Invalid start yields false, not NaN, and page defaulting is independent; but the CoT's 'NaN then false' trace is essentially right.
Test use is right, but it leaves out the production use: tabbedbrowser.py constructs signalfilter.SignalFilter.
Signature requirement is right, but it drops user configurability and filtering, which the issue states as expected behavior.
Leaves out test usage: test_version builds DistributionInfo expectations with version values and compares them to distribution() output.
Generator stamps v1.28.1, not the checked-in v1.28.1-devel, so output is not byte-exact; refutation rests on a cosmetic header.
Plain git diff compares working tree to index; the implication holds only with a clean index, as in CI.
Mismatch is real, but the descriptor-driven protobuf runtime silently ignores the extra struct field; no runtime error follows.
src2asciidoc sorts configdata.DATA values before emitting, so order is sorted, not YAML insertion order.
These results are standard Qt; Qt never zero-pads in ==, only normalized() makes 5.4 and 5.4.0 equivalent.
Says the client avoids GET /api/v3/chats, but chat.js calls api.get('/chats', {uid, after: 0}); raw pass-through changes its behavior.
States separate new/resolved/updated collections are required; one union pass assigning statuses into a single VulnInfos map also works.
rawDesc is plain wire-encoded FileDescriptorProto bytes in a []byte; no base64, and gzip only via rawDescGZIP.
In flipt.proto EvaluationRequest (line 35) precedes MatchType (198) and ComparisonType (271), so proto order differs from the slice.
Names nonexistent InputNameIndex/OutputNameIndex fields; v1.28.1 resolveServices passes md.L1.Input and md.L1.Output.
Aliases are not harmless: TestMigratorExpectedVersions reads a migration directory per stringToDriver key, so cockroach/crdb entries fail.
The section also introduces the DiffStatus type and DiffPlus/DiffMinus constants, not only model methods.
A relative replace target must contain its own go.mod; the plan leaves out that required file.
Format holds for the current PyQt reprs observed, but is generalized to legacy PyQt <5.11, whose unbound reprs differ.
Only page is deprecated and superseded by start; perPage carries no deprecation marker.
attribute.String takes a string key; semconv.DBSystemKey is attribute.Key, so the call does not type-check.
Works when keys are omitted, but leaves out explicit false: without presence tracking it is indistinguishable from omission.
A missing uid maps through isFinite(value) && parseInt to false, not undefined.
With undefined roomId both helpers return normally; only an undefined mid can make canViewMessage reject, isUserInRoom never throws.
Picks the postgres adapter instead of the required golang-migrate CockroachDB driver; its pg_advisory_lock does not work on CockroachDB.
Claims strict pre-default timing; verifier notes raw req.query can be checked later, but that is still validating pre-default data.
Forwarding is true, but validation need not live in the API layer; controller, middleware or socket checks also satisfy requirements.
Requirements also prescribe runtime reasons, e.g. FLAG_NOT_FOUND_EVALUATION_REASON for missing flags, beyond protobuf and Swagger schema.
Diff is a bool on config.Config accessed via c.Conf; no ReportConf type owns it.
Direct-call half holds, but HTTP does not require a controller change; route middleware or an API check of req.query works.
FileDescriptorProto keeps messages and enums in separate repeated fields; the raw descriptor is not one interleaved file-order sequence.
Test ranges over all stringToDriver keys; but the CoT likely meant only 'cockroachdb' is added, so the refutation targets a misparse.
Greedy .* before (\w+) leaves only the last character, so m.group(1) returns '1', not signal1.
DatabaseConfig.validate only checks protocol/host/name presence; there is no MaxOpenConn range check.
